name: task_decomposition
content: You are an expert task decomposition analyst. Break down the following task into logical subtasks WITH category hints.
- Break the task into clear, actionable subtasks
- Each subtask should be specific and executable

variables.name: task
variables.description: The task to decompose into subtasks

variables.name: context_section
variables.description: Parent context from previous decomposition levels
examples: CONTEXT: Parent task was checking server health

variables.name: categories_section
variables.description: Available tool categories for narrowing search space (reduces 8000 tools to 15-50 per category)
examples:
AVAILABLE TOOL CATEGORIES:
(Suggest ONE category per subtask to narrow tool search space)
- network
- browser
- http
- monitoring
- diagnostics

variables.name: estimated_subtasks
variables.description: Target number of subtasks to generate

variables.name: category_requirement
variables.description: Additional requirement line about category specification
examples: - For EACH subtask, specify which CATEGORY has tools for it

variables.name: format_line_1
variables.description: First line of format example showing response structure

variables.name: example_line_1
variables.default_value: 1. Retrieve customer data from database (complexity: 0.4, dependencies: [])
examples: 1. Resolve DNS for target | Category: network | Complexity: 0.3 | Dependencies: []
1. Retrieve customer data from database (complexity: 0.4, dependencies: [])

variables.name: example_line_2
examples: 2. Test TCP connection | Category: network | Complexity: 0.4 | Dependencies: [1]

variables.name: example_line_3
examples: 3. Verify response status | Category: diagnostics | Complexity: 0.3 | Dependencies: [2]

metadata.description: Intelligent task decomposition with category-guided tool discovery support. Breaks down complex tasks into executable subtasks with optional category hints to narrow tool search space from 8000 to 15-50 tools.
metadata.author: MagicianV2
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial version with category-guided decomposition support. Supports both category-aware and legacy decomposition modes.
